decks.notes: The deck focuses on controlling the game through counterspells, removal, and powerful planeswalkers like Jace and Teferi. It utilizes cards like Chalice of the Void and Archmage's Charm to disrupt the opponent's game plan, while also having access to versatile removal options such as Prismatic Ending. The deck also includes a companion, Kaheera, to provide additional value. With a mana base that includes dual lands and fetch lands, the deck aims to stabilize the board and outvalue the opponent in a longer game.

This UR Aggro deck focuses on overwhelming the opponent with aggressive creatures like Murktide Regent and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, while disrupting their game plan with cards like Counterspell and Lightning Bolt. The deck aims to control the board early on with efficient removal spells like Unholy Heat and tempo plays like Dragon's Rage Channeler. Mishra's Bauble and Expressive Iteration help maintain card advantage and card selection. The deck also includes a versatile land base to ensure consistent mana production. Overall, the deck aims to apply pressure while maintaining control over the game.

The deck focuses on utilizing Elementals with strong board presence and synergy to control the game. It includes powerful Elemental creatures like Omnath, Locus of Creation and Risen Reef, along with support cards like Thunderkin Awakener and Solitude. The inclusion of Ephemerate and Vesperlark allows for recurring value from the creatures. The deck also utilizes the companion Kaheera, the Orphanguard for additional support and consistency. Overall, the strategy revolves around proactive control elements while leveraging the Elemental tribal synergy to overwhelm opponents.

The deck focuses on utilizing cards that provide value through ETB effects and recursion, while controlling the board with removal spells and counterspells. It aims to outvalue the opponent with powerful creatures like Sun Titan and Skyclave Apparition, along with disruptive cards like Teferi, Time Raveler. The inclusion of Yorion as a companion allows for additional consistency and card advantage. The deck has a strong mana base with various utility lands to support the control strategy.

The deck focuses on fast and aggressive plays, using low-cost creatures and burn spells to quickly deal damage to the opponent. It aims to win the game as quickly as possible by constantly pressuring the opponent and keeping them on the back foot. The deck includes a mix of creatures with haste and direct damage spells to maintain a steady stream of damage. By utilizing efficient cards and maximizing damage output, the deck aims to overpower the opponent before they have a chance to stabilize and turn the game in their favor.

The main concept behind this deck is to quickly assemble the combo pieces, specifically Colossus Hammer and Puresteel Paladin, to create a powerful and fast win condition. The deck utilizes various equipment and creatures to ensure consistency and protection, allowing for explosive turns and overwhelming opponents with a lethal attack. The addition of Urza's Saga adds an extra layer of synergy and card advantage, further enhancing the overall strategy of the deck. Overall, the deck aims to efficiently and effectively execute its combo to secure victory in Modern 1 vs 1 matches.

The deck focuses on assembling a powerful combo using equipment cards like Colossus Hammer and Sigarda's Aid to equip them for free, enabling a swift and powerful offense. The deck also includes creatures like Puresteel Paladin and Stoneforge Mystic to search for and play additional equipment cards efficiently. Additionally, the inclusion of cards like Giver of Runes and The Reality Chip provides protection and additional utility to support the deck's strategy. With a mix of efficient creatures, powerful equipment, and synergistic cards, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents quickly and decisively.

The deck focuses on assembling the Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle combo with cards like Primeval Titan and Scapeshift to deal massive amounts of damage to the opponent in a single turn. It uses ramp cards like Sakura-Tribe Elder and Search for Tomorrow to quickly get to the necessary lands. Dryad of the Ilysian Grove helps fix mana and allows for multiple land drops per turn. Wrenn and Six provides card advantage and helps to recur important lands. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with powerful landfall triggers and burn spells.

This deck focuses on quickly assembling the Amulet Titan combo to generate massive amounts of mana and consistently tutor for key cards. By utilizing cards like Amulet of Vigor, Primeval Titan, and Urza's Saga, the deck aims to ramp up quickly and overwhelm the opponent with powerful threats. The deck also includes utility lands like Boros Garrison and Gruul Turf, as well as protection with Cavern of Souls. With a mix of ramp, tutoring, and land synergy, the deck aims to create explosive turns and close out the game efficiently.

This deck focuses on quickly casting powerful spells with cascade to overwhelm the opponent. By using cards like Shardless Agent and Violent Outburst, the deck can cascade into cards like Crashing Footfalls and Fury for explosive plays. The deck also includes countermagic like Mystical Dispute and Force of Negation to protect its threats. Utilizing a mix of versatile cards for removal and tempo control, the deck aims to maintain pressure on the opponent while disrupting their game plan. The land base includes a mix of fetch lands and utility lands to ensure consistency and flexibility.

This Modern deck focuses on using Cascade spells to overwhelm opponents with aggressive creature spells and disruptive instant-speed effects. The key strategy is to cast Cascade spells like Violent Outburst or Shardless Agent to cheat out powerful creature spells like Crashing Footfalls or Bonecrusher Giant, while also using cards like Fury and Brazen Borrower to control the board and protect your threats. The deck aims to quickly build a board presence and apply pressure to the opponent, while also disrupting their game plan with counterspells and removal spells.

The deck focuses on assembling a toolbox of creature cards that can be searched for and played at the right moment to create a powerful combination of abilities. By using cards like Chord of Calling and Eldritch Evolution, the deck can quickly find the right creatures to control the board and generate value through sacrifice effects and +1/+1 counters. The key is to efficiently use the creatures' abilities in conjunction with one another to overwhelm the opponent and secure victory in the late game.

The deck focuses on quickly assembling the powerful combo of Colossus Hammer and Puresteel Paladin to create a lethal threat. The combination of cheap equipment spells, such as Stoneforge Mystic, and efficient creatures like Ornithopter allow for a fast and aggressive start. The deck can protect its combo pieces with Giver of Runes and disrupt opponents with counterspells like Spell Pierce. Urza's Saga provides additional utility and card advantage. The goal is to overwhelm opponents with a huge, indestructible, and double-striking creature for a swift victory.

This deck focuses on assembling the combo of Colossus Hammer and a creature to equip it to, allowing for powerful, fast attacks. The deck includes cards that support this strategy, such as Puresteel Paladin and Stoneforge Mystic to help find the necessary pieces quickly. The inclusion of Urza's Saga and equipment tutors like Steelshaper's Gift ensure consistency in setting up the combo. The deck also includes protection in the form of Giver of Runes and Spell Pierce, allowing for a strong offense while maintaining defense against opposing threats.

This UR Aggro deck focuses on quickly deploying threats like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Murktide Regent while disrupting the opponent's game plan with counterspells like Counterspell and Unholy Heat. The deck also utilizes card advantage engines like Mishra's Bauble and Expressive Iteration to maintain tempo and pressure. The mana base supports the aggressive strategy with efficient dual lands and fetch lands to ensure consistent color access. The combination of aggressive creatures, disruptive spells, and card advantage tools makes this deck a fast-paced and versatile threat in the Modern format.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly ramp up mana using cards like Sakura-Tribe Elder and Search for Tomorrow, while utilizing Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle as a win condition. Dryad of the Ilysian Grove and Primeval Titan help produce additional land drops, and the deck includes cards like Scapeshift and Wrenn and Six to quickly assemble the combo and deal massive damage to the opponent. Lightning Bolt provides removal and reach, making this deck a potent and consistent combo deck in the Modern format.
